sources.snippet: Available for Gemma 4 E2B, E4B, 12B, and 31B. Assistant Compatibility: When using multi-token prediction (speculative decoding) with an assistant model alongside a QAT target model, the assistant model must also be a QAT checkpoint with the same precision to ensure compatibility.
